page.notes: Several readings are doubtful because of the print and the scan. Marked [?]: "euenīat" (line 'opera nostra nō ideo...'), "stropha" (papistarum entry). The entry "palæsthini de uictoria... Dagoni a-gunt" is a hyphenated line break whose continuation is read as "gunt". "paruelium" in the last line may be "patruelium"; it is copied as printed in the letter form the scan shows, and marked here rather than corrected. Printing errors left as printed: "Oraculu", "otium ueterum" (read as ueterum), "Ouorum", "parez" (read as "parez", may be "Parez"). Long s is written as plain s throughout. Page number is not printed on this scan. Two small ornaments at the foot are not transcribed.
